about.description: Markets by Kinetiq is a HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetual venue on Hyperliquid covering public equities, equity indices, and commodities (including international names like Tencent, Xiaomi, and the Nikkei 225). Founded in late 2024 by a 13-person team led by pseudonymous founder Omnia.hl and CTO Justin Greenberg, Kinetiq raised $1.75M from Hyperliquid-ecosystem investors and partnered with Kaiko for institutional 24/7 global market data. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH; markets appear under the km namespace on Hyperliquid. Kinetiq's broader stack also includes kHYPE liquid staking and a "Launch" platform that lets third-party teams deploy their own HIP-3 perpetual exchanges.
about.registryInfo: Kinetiq was founded in late 2024 by a 13-person team active in crypto since 2013, led by pseudonymous founder Omnia.hl ("0xOmnia") and Co-Founder/CTO Justin Greenberg. The team raised $1.75M seed funding from investors within the Hyperliquid ecosystem. Beyond Markets (perpetual trading), Kinetiq operates kHYPE liquid staking, iHYPE institutional staking, and a Launch platform that lets external teams deploy their own HIP-3 perpetual exchanges; Kaiko provides institutional market data.

fees.revenueNotes: Markets by Kinetiq is a HIP-3 builder-deployer on Hyperliquid. Fees follow HIP-3 framework: standard taker ~7-9 bps, Growth Mode taker ~0.45-0.9 bps. 50% of fees go to Kinetiq deployer, 50% to Hyperliquid protocol. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals
